handback.title: The fence reads its scope only from the plan
handback.summary: Deletes the fence's old reader of a scope written in the issue's text.
handback.user_story: The fence takes its scope only from the plan file, as every run already passes it.

acceptance_criteria.text: The fence no longer reads its scope from the issue's text.
acceptance_criteria.words: reads Scope from issue text; agent.yml always passes plan.json

edge_cases.case: A plan file still keeps the files its criteria list.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tests that only check the deleted reader are deleted too.
acceptance_criteria.words: Delete it, plus the tests that only exercise it.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The planner deletes the one such test; nothing varies by input.

test_changes.tests/test_fence.py::test_scope_is_read_: Only checked the issue text reader, which this issue deletes.
test_changes.tests/test_fence.py::test_tampering_is_u: Passes its scope as a list, not through the deleted reader.
test_changes.tests/test_fence.py::test_an_honest_buil: Passes its scope as a list, not through the deleted reader.
test_changes.tests/test_scope_from_files.py::test_sco: Reads the scope the plan check records, not through the deleted reader.
